place.source_title: Chanute Air Force Base, Non-Commissioned Officer Housing, Destroyer Street

brief: Two-storey brick Colonial Revival duplex of about 1942 built as wartime housing: a hipped roof, two front doors under a shared pedimented porch on columns, 6/6 windows and a big end chimney; plain lawn and street trees.

floors: W W W W W W

facade.notes: Chanute Field non-commissioned officers' housing (Rantoul IL, 1942): two-storey hip-roofed brick duplexes of one standard plan, paired doors under a shared pedimented hood with fanlights, an iron-railed stoop, a tall end chimney, 6/6 sash; foundation shrubs; set evenly along a sidewalk with lawns flowing between

why.note: Army standard-plan NCO quarters: two families per building, repeated
